Topics · Death and what comes after

Will anyone stand with me on Judgment Day?

Each comes alone; the next verse speaks of love. Intercession by God's leave, hope of meeting those we love.

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَكُلُّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فَرْدًا٩٥ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وُدًّا٩٦﴾

Translation of the meaning

And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone. Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.[829]

Translator's notes

[829] From Himself and from among each other.

Quran · Maryam 19:95-96

Translation

He said, “Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked will I return there. Yahweh gave, and Yahweh has taken away. Blessed be Yahweh’s name.”

Original · Hebrew

וַיֹּאמֶר֩ עָרֹ֨ם יָצָ֜אתִי מִבֶּ֣טֶן אִמִּ֗י וְעָרֹם֙ אָשׁ֣וּב שָׁ֔מָה יְהוָ֣ה נָתַ֔ן וַיהוָ֖ה לָקָ֑ח יְהִ֛י שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה מְבֹרָֽךְ׃

Job · 1:21

World English Bible

﴿وَلَقَدْ جِئْتُمُونَا فُرَٰدَىٰ كَمَا خَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَتَرَكْتُم مَّا خَوَّلْنَـٰكُمْ وَرَآءَ ظُهُورِكُمْ ۖ وَمَا نَرَىٰ مَعَكُمْ شُفَعَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُمْ أَنَّهُمْ فِيكُمْ شُرَكَـٰٓؤُا۟ ۚ لَقَد تَّقَطَّعَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَضَلَّ عَنكُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

[It will be said to them], "And you have certainly come to Us alone [i.e., individually] as We created you the first time, and you have left whatever We bestowed upon you behind you. And We do not see with you your 'intercessors' which you claimed that they were among you associates [of Allāh]. It has [all] been severed between you,[328] and lost from you is what you used to claim."

Translator's notes

[328] Between yourselves and the claimed associates and intercessors.

Quran · Al-An'am 6:94

Translation

For no king had a different beginning, but all men have one entrance into life, and a common departure.

Original · Ancient Greek

Οὐδεὶς γὰρ βασιλεὺς ἑτέραν ἔσχε γενέσεως ἀρχήν. Μία δὲ πάντων εἴσοδος εἰς τὸν βίον, ἔξοδός τε ἴση.

Wisdom · 7:5-6

World English Bible

No one can answer for you, and no one can take your place. That is what responsibility means: you come alone, as you were born alone, leaving behind what you leaned on. Yet this aloneness also protects you. No one speaks over you, and no one else's deeds are charged to you. And the very next verse says the Merciful will give love to those who believe and do good.

A question for you

What is on your mind most when you think of standing alone?

If you sayThat no one will speak up for me.
ThenThe next part is about exactly this.
If you sayBeing parted from those I love.
ThenThe last part of this Step is for that. Keep it in mind.
If you sayI do not know if there is such a Day.
ThenThen an earlier question deserves to come first.

Part 2 of 3

﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةُ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَرَضِىَ لَهُۥ قَوْلًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

That Day, no intercession will benefit except [that of] one to whom the Most Merciful has given permission and has accepted his word.

Quran · Ta-Ha 20:109

﴿قُلْ يَـٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh forgives all sins.[1354] Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."

Translator's notes

[1354] For those who repent and correct themselves.

Quran · Az-Zumar 39:53

Translation

Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy on him, to our God, for he will freely pardon.

Original · Hebrew

יַעֲזֹ֤ב רָשָׁע֙ דַּרְכּ֔וֹ וְאִ֥ישׁ אָ֖וֶן מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֑יו וְיָשֹׁ֤ב אֶל־יְהוָה֙ וִֽירַחֲמֵ֔הוּ וְאֶל־אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ כִּֽי־יַרְבֶּ֥ה לִסְלֽוֹחַ׃

Isaiah · 55:7

World English Bible

If no one holds power alongside God, no one can step in by their own force. That does not mean every door is shut. The verse says intercession benefits the one the Merciful permits and whose word He accepts. So it is no pressure applied to God; it is a gift from Him. Who holds it, then? The same One who says in the second verse: do not lose hope.

A question for you

From what you have read, whose is intercession?

If you sayGod's, who permits it to whom He wills.
ThenThat is what 39:44 says. Any question about the Prophet's intercession starts from here.
If you sayThe prophets' and the righteous.
ThenThe verses speak of an intercession by leave. Compare the two in the next Step.
If you sayI do not know.
ThenRead the name the Merciful in the verse once more, and start from there.

Part 3 of 3

﴿جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ ءَابَآئِهِمْ وَأَزْوَٰجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِهِمْ ۖ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَدْخُلُونَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن كُلِّ بَابٍ٢٣ سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكُم بِمَا صَبَرْتُمْ ۚ فَنِعْمَ عُقْبَى ٱلدَّارِ٢٤﴾

Translation of the meaning

Gardens of perpetual residence; they will enter them with whoever were righteous among their forefathers, their spouses and their descendants. And the angels will enter upon them from every gate, [saying], "Peace [i.e., security] be upon you for what you patiently endured." And excellent is the final home.

Quran · Ar-Ra'd 13:23-24

﴿وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَـٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَـٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds.[1554] Every person, for what he earned, is retained.[1555]

Translator's notes

[1554] i.e., the reward thereof. [1555] i.e., subject or held responsible. Literally, "a hostage."

Quran · At-Tur 52:21

Translation

Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine. The soul who sins, he shall die.

Original · Hebrew

הֵ֤ן כָּל־הַנְּפָשׁוֹת֙ לִ֣י הֵ֔נָּה כְּנֶ֧פֶשׁ הָאָ֛ב וּכְנֶ֥פֶשׁ הַבֵּ֖ן לִי־הֵ֑נָּה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַחֹטֵ֖את הִ֥יא תָמֽוּת׃

Ezekiel · 18:4

World English Bible

If a person comes alone, is love cut off forever? The verses do not say so. The first describes gardens entered by the righteous with those of their parents, spouses and children who did good. The second says believing children are joined to them, with nothing taken from anyone's deeds. So standing alone is not the end of the scene. There is a reunion, and goodness is its road.

A question for you

Whom do you hope to meet there?

If you saySomeone I have lost.
ThenCarry that hope with you. Prayer for those who have gone has its place in the Quran (59:10).
If you sayMy whole family.
ThenThe verse makes goodness the road to that. What could you do together today?
If you sayI do not know.
ThenThis question can stay with you quietly.
